text.text_excerpt: Galaxie is the hot new taco place on the Bywater block and I was pretty excited to check it out. The restaurant is actually a former gas station that's been totally redone and made into a taco sanctuary, if you will. Ordering is pretty basic: you order at the counter, they give you a number and you go into, what I assume was maybe a garage or something, at some point, and sit down. There's also a bar and you can eat there. On my visit, I got an order of the grilled queso, black beans and an al pastor quesadilla. The grilled queso was good but, I'm gonna be honest, it was basically just melted cheese. I'm not mad at that at all, but I would have loved to have a tortilla to wrap it in. The ...

Galaxie has some solid tacos and drinks but the highlight is their pandemic operation. It was the first place we went when we felt comfortable and probably the most comfortable I'll feel because they have a roomy outdoor setup that allows for proper spacing and then some. It feels like an oasis. The weather was beautiful which didn't hurt. Out of the shrimp, al pastor, and fish tacos, the fish was my favorite. All of the right flavors, I just wish the piece of fish was slightly larger. We also had their queso which was not a 'dipping situation,' we were warned, but instead was fried cheese. Very good, pretty salty, and the green salsa to go with it was deeeelicious. Their drink special th...

I went to Galaxie for Happy Hour and with Happy Hour pricing, it was great!!! I really liked their Margarita. We had Jalisco Sour as well but it was ok - I would not order it again though. As for Tacos, It is true that they are small. If you went to Rosalita's next door before, it is literally about half the size of Rosalita's. BUT I have to say their tacos are SO SO SO Freaking good... They might be small and mighty, every bite had a nice flavorful punch. I had Veggie and Brisket one and Gosh Brisket one was... probably the best brisket taco I have ever had in town. Ambiance is Super casual and do not expect a table service.
